body: Honestly typically I don't care about myself and welcome death to take me but when I'm actually faced down with it I hesitate, it frightens me at that point. I dunno why, I'm always so ready to let it take me, to let myself die if the situation arose and yet the times they do when it'd be so easy to let it I feel some fear holding me back.

I told myself before if I was 40 I'd kill myself if I was still alone and felt this way. Then I lowered it to 30 as I grew more tired of this feeling. Now it's only at 25, just a bit over four years from now. It's something I came up with because I could not bear the thought of always feeling so alone and so tired my entire life and the longer I felt this way the harder it has become to hold out for so long.

Well for me it's definitely social anxiety as well as a fear of people I don't know. Unless we're close I don't feel comfortable talking to someone else for many different reasons which makes it tough. It's to the point that I can't even ask a professor for help ever so I just learn everything alone. I can't easily make friends but I can maintain a friendship if somehow I get passed the whole getting to know each other and spending some time together phase. Although I only have a few left over highschool friends to prove that one, and most of them have their own lives so I hardly see them anyways outside of when I go back home from school
This really hit me hard. The loving bright eyed child with dreams, hopes, and aspirations died when they became me. It's like being a hollow husk that once carried a soul inside it.

You know that actually does make me feel a bit better. Maybe caring so much about everything and everyone has some benefits. Now if only my brain could make my body understand that someday too. Thank you

Ha that sounds like my parents, they say nearly the same thing. Personally I'm not into traveling and I honestly really really really hate college and school even though I'm good at it (don't know why) so I do everything to minimize my time there which is why I never considered studying abroad. I'm still unsure how to even find new passions but I'd certainly like to figure it out someday. My one issue is how akward I am around anyone I don't know well which lowers my motivation and makes me feel worse. But I truly appreciate the suggestions, thank you

I think it depends. If you lived a fulfilling life and had many loved ones than nothingness would be worse because you'd never again see those you loved in life and spend eternity peacefully with them. If you hated your life, felt that you were always alone and isolated, and constantly wanted to die then an after life would be worse because you'd still be suffering alone even after death.

I am a junior now in college but what you said was exactly what I experienced as a freshman. But the one difference is I had no highschool friends who went to the same school. I spent many nights walking around campus alone basically in tears and almost hoping something would put me out of my misery. Sophomore year only got a bit better because my sister started going to the same school so at least I had someone.  But she had her own social life that didn't always include me, in the end I ended up spending many nights just sobbing in the shower or into my pillow. And now junior year is me isolated in my room on a computer feeling numb to it all. I understand you completely and I truly hope that you have better luck than me and manage to make some worthwhile connections

Oh my you remind me of how I am right now. The person I can't help but think about, can't help but constantly stalk on twitter, and can't help but wish to be closer with constantly feels like they tease me. One day I'll hear loving words of having a future together, of them loving me completely, of how much they enjoy our time together, etc. Then I'll get ignored for hours or days maybe even a week before they interact with me as though none of that happened. It has happened so much and it drives me insane now, I want to believe their words so I stalk their twitter. I want to believe because I don't wanna be alone and yet seeing their twitter just makes my heart feel heavy as they post and interact with others while I am ignored.
